request.purpose: Compute the conditional lever-rule map from assumed total variant RNA mass fraction to dilute-phase volume fraction for each supplied E04 tie-line; quantify how the result changes across endpoint marginal-error corners and compare the relative partition ratios. This tests a conditional mechanism consequence, not whether B follows it.

variables_units.x_var: variant fraction by total RNA mass, dimensionless assumed 0..1

assumptions: Closed two-phase system, conserved reference and variant masses, fixed coexisting endpoints within each tie-line, and no third component or source/sink during the algebraic lever-rule calculation.
x_var is a hypothetical independently measured RNA mass fraction; DNA read fractions are not RNA fractions.
Supplied marginal lower/upper endpoint bounds are varied as corners for sensitivity only; do not call them confidence intervals.
E04 endpoints are not B time-course measurements and do not identify an internal cavity phase or image geometry.
model_spec.range_conditions: For each tie_line_id 0,1,2, evaluate x_var=0,0.1,...,1.0. Compute phi_l=(C_var,d-r*C_ref,d)/(r*(C_ref,l-C_ref,d)-(C_var,l-C_var,d)), r=x_var/(1-x_var); handle x_var=1 with the species-only limit. Retain only values in [0,1] as lever-rule-compatible; flag invalid values. Recompute at all combinations of lower/upper supplied endpoint bounds (16 corners per tie-line), skipping undefined K ratios when a dilute concentration is zero. Include central endpoint K_ref,K_var and K_var/K_ref where defined. Report residual reconstruction of normalized masses for valid points, equal-partition/zero-species/degenerate checks, and whether relative preference direction differs across tie-lines.
